findings.text: The COMPRESSION variable now contains 'tar.gz' or 'tar.xz' (from nvm_get_artifact_compression), but the TARBALL path construction removed '.tar.' from the template, producing malformed filenames like 'node-v14.0.0tar.gz' instead of 'node-v14.0.0.tar.gz', causing tarball extraction to fail.
